item.title: Super El Niño 2025‑26: Climate Change Boosts Record Heat
item.description: A 'super' El Niño forecast for winter 2025‑26 may push ocean temps past historic highs, linking with climate change to spark severe global impacts.

item.title: El Niño Heat Domes Keep US Autumn Unseasonably Warm
item.description: A strong El Niño and climate change drive heat domes, keeping September 5‑10°F above normal across the US and stressing regional water resources.
